story_title: How AI Agents Are Transforming Complex Work
caption:
AI is moving past single chat responses. A new research paper from OpenAI shows how AI agents are transforming work by handling complex, multi-step tasks across roles.

Here is how the shift from assistant to delegate is changing productivity. 👇

pinned_comment: Are you using AI for quick prompts or multi-step agent workflows in your daily work?
alt_text_overall: Carousel explaining OpenAI research on how AI agents are transforming work through multi-step tasks.
alt_text_per_slide: Slide 1: AI IS STOPPING THE CHAT.. OpenAI research reveals a major shift: AI is moving from quick prompt responses to executing complex, multi-step workflows. — shown as a bold statement over a torn-edge color block.

Slide 2: FROM ASSISTANTS TO DELEGATES.. Instead of generating isolated answers, modern AI agents are handling longer operational tasks across diverse professional roles. — shown as a numbered slide beside a large offset circle.

Slide 3: EXPANDING PRODUCTIVITY ACROSS ROLES.. According to OpenAI, agentic tools enable longer operational execution, expanding productivity capabilities beyond simple text generation. — shown as a numbered slide beside a large offset circle.

Slide 4: MULTI-STEP COMPLEXITY IS NOW standard.. Tasks that previously broke down after a few steps can now be sustained across longer context horizons and dynamic decision trees. — shown as a numbered slide beside a large offset circle.

Slide 5: THIS ISN'T JUST AUTOMATION.. It represents a structural shift in human-computer interaction: moving from manual execution to strategic oversight. — shown as a numbered slide beside a large offset circle.

Slide 6: WHAT THIS MEANS FOR WORKERS.. Productivity gains will increasingly belong to those who build, manage, and audit agentic systems rather than manually completing linear steps. — shown as a numbered slide beside a large offset circle.
Slide 7: THE AGENT ERA HAS STARTED.. AI is no longer just answering your questions. It is learning to do the work. — shown as a bold statement over a torn-edge color block.
